cases.name: v1-to-v16-minimal
cases.notes: A v1 database with only a repos table (root_path still present, no rows): every create-step runs, the fs adapter row is ensured, root_path is dropped, pending_materializations is created. Mirrors store.test.ts 'migrates an older (v1) database forward'.
setup: CREATE TABLE repos (repo_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT, root_path TEXT, settings TEXT)

cases.name: v12-to-v13-root-path-becomes-fs-source
cases.notes: README §3.4 step 13: the repo's root_path becomes a source `<slug>-fs` (source_id minted with prefix src → src_0), attached to the repo; the column is dropped.
setup: CREATE TABLE repos (repo_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, root_path TEXT, settings TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')
CREATE TABLE adapters (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, command TEXT NOT NULL, args TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]')
CREATE TABLE sources (source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, adapter TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES adapters(name), config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', env TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')
CREATE TABLE attachments (repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(source_id), PRIMARY KEY (repo_id, source_id))
INSERT INTO repos (repo_id, slug, root_path) VALUES ('rp_1','vault','/data/vault')

cases.name: v12-to-v13-empty-root-path-gets-no-source
cases.notes: A repo whose root_path is NULL or '' gets no source and no attachment; the adapter row is still ensured and the column still dropped.

CREATE TABLE sources (source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, adapter TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES adapters(name), config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', env TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')
CREATE TABLE attachments (repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(source_id), PRIMARY KEY (repo_id, source_id))

cases.name: v13-to-v14-pending-materializations
cases.notes: README §3.4 step 14: a v13 database gains the empty `pending_materializations` table (the api path's recorded file intent, §5.7); nothing else moves — the repo row is untouched.
setup: CREATE TABLE repos (repo_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, settings TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

cases.name: v14-to-v15-revisions-nullable-and-archives
cases.notes: README §3.4 step 15: a v14 database's `revisions` table is rebuilt so that `root_tree`/`frontmatter_blob` are nullable without foreign keys and `archive` exists (every existing row keeps its bodies and gets `archive = NULL`), and `archives` is created — with foreign keys off for the duration, so the `pending_materializations` row that references the revision survives the DROP/RENAME. The commit, doc and pending rows are untouched.
setup: CREATE TABLE repos (repo_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, settings TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

CREATE TABLE docs (doc_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), path TEXT NOT NULL, format TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'markdown', current_rev TEXT, file_hash BLOB, conflicted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, leading_trivia TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', frontmatter_trivia TEXT, deleted_commit TEXT, UNIQUE (repo_id, path))
CREATE TABLE blobs (hash BLOB PRIMARY KEY, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE tree_nodes (hash BLOB PRIMARY KEY, entries TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE commits (commit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL, ts TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('api','observed','import','projection')), actor TEXT, reason TEXT, checkpoint_id TEXT, ops TEXT, UNIQUE (repo_id, seq))

CREATE TABLE revisions (rev_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, doc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES docs(doc_id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL, root_tree BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES tree_nodes(hash), frontmatter_blob BLOB REFERENCES blobs(hash), rendered_hash BLOB NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commits(commit_id), UNIQUE (doc_id, seq))

CREATE TABLE pending_materializations (repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), path TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('write','rename','remove')), from_path TEXT, doc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES docs(doc_id), rev_id TEXT REFERENCES revisions(rev_id), rendered_hash BLOB NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commits(commit_id), PRIMARY KEY (repo_id, path))
INSERT INTO repos (repo_id, slug) VALUES ('rp_1','vault')
INSERT INTO docs (doc_id, repo_id, path, current_rev, file_hash) VALUES ('d_1','rp_1','a.md','r_1', X'00')
INSERT INTO tree_nodes (hash, entries) VALUES (X'01', '[]')
INSERT INTO blobs (hash, bytes, size) VALUES (X'02', X'2d2d2d0a2d2d2d', 7)
INSERT INTO commits (commit_id, repo_id, seq, ts, origin) VALUES ('c_1','rp_1',1,'2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z','api')
INSERT INTO revisions (rev_id, doc_id, seq, root_tree, frontmatter_blob, rendered_hash, path, commit_id) VALUES ('r_1','d_1',1,X'01',X'02',X'03','a.md','c_1')
INSERT INTO pending_materializations (repo_id, path, kind, doc_id, rev_id, rendered_hash, commit_id) VALUES ('rp_1','a.md','write','d_1','r_1',X'03','c_1')

cases.name: v15-to-v16-is-lazy
cases.notes: §3.4 step 16: no DDL and no data pass. A 15.x store's nodes are all `[`-form and its frontmatter blobs all raw — exactly the 16.0 checkpoint forms — so every existing revision is a checkpoint and the step only moves user_version; the rows are untouched byte for byte. Deltas appear with the next commit (§4.4).
setup: CREATE TABLE repos (repo_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, settings TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

CREATE TABLE docs (doc_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), path TEXT NOT NULL, format TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'markdown', current_rev TEXT, file_hash BLOB, conflicted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, leading_trivia TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', frontmatter_trivia TEXT, deleted_commit TEXT, UNIQUE (repo_id, path))
CREATE TABLE blobs (hash BLOB PRIMARY KEY, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE tree_nodes (hash BLOB PRIMARY KEY, entries TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE commits (commit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL, ts TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('api','observed','import','projection')), actor TEXT, reason TEXT, checkpoint_id TEXT, ops TEXT, UNIQUE (repo_id, seq))

CREATE TABLE revisions (rev_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, doc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES docs(doc_id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL, root_tree BLOB, frontmatter_blob BLOB, rendered_hash BLOB NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commits(commit_id), archive TEXT, UNIQUE (doc_id, seq))

CREATE TABLE pending_materializations (repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), path TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('write','rename','remove')), from_path TEXT, doc_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES docs(doc_id), rev_id TEXT REFERENCES revisions(rev_id), rendered_hash BLOB NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commits(commit_id), PRIMARY KEY (repo_id, path))

CREATE TABLE archives (segment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(repo_id), path TEXT NOT NULL, seq_lo INTEGER NOT NULL, seq_hi INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, revision_count INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL)
